<thought>Search the template catalog for retrosynthetic templates that, in the forward direction, break a ketone and a C‑C triple bond, break a C‑O bond (format “6-8”), and form a C‑C sigma bond (format “6-6”).</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "COC(C1(C=C1[Si](C)(C)C)/C=C/C2=CC=CC=C2)=O",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["ketones", "C-C triple bonds"],
    "functional_groups_formed": null,
    "bonds_formed": ["6-6"],
    "bonds_broken": ["6-8"],
    "bonds_order_changed": null,
    "limit": 5
}
</action_input>
